text: We booked Heather for a live wedding painting, and she was absolutely one of our favorite wedding vendors! She is SO talented, easy to work with, responsive, and you will be blown away with the painting.  We had a couple of ideas and Heather incorporated them all into our painting, and the level of detail far exceeded our expectations.  If you’re even remotely considering a wedding painter, I’d recommend Heather a million times over. Oh and, our guests loved watching her during our reception too!

owner_reply.text: Emily, thank you so much for having me be a part of your wedding. It was an honor! Your wedding was truly breathtaking!
